additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412517-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R2 170001542] Plug holder is cracked CRM:00797001777
additional_info.body:
Hello Sominath
Went today on site the following things were remarqued.
Plug holder is indeed cracked as the customer states, therefor it will be changed under warranty.
Charger is stuck at the “first” hallo/hello screen and won't continue to the customers configuration. I tried to rewrite the cfast card but the plc won't recognize it anymore. During the installation at the step please “insert cfast card” the charger is doing nothing when you insert the card. Therefor the cfast card is corrupted I think. We will also continue by replacing this card under warranty.
Br.

additional_info.subject: Bas on site 30.04.25 and 02.05.25
additional_info.body:
Hello
Charger is investigated with help of L3
@KS, Sambath (SI E CS SD ES)
. Boot issue from KF1 PLC solved by work around from L3. Cfast card had to be inserted instead of out as mentioned in work sheet.
New charger created in SCB due to unknown reason, issue with Linux bootable image? New charger ID 1Y9xGI
New SCB charger ID is prepared by L3, Hardware issue found and causes charger to not work. See attached pictures.
All 3 surge fuses are measured to be broken and need to be replaced. Component F01-FC1. This is a live AC incoming part so incoming AC needs to be turned off to continue working safe.
Parts needed:
@Iovine, Monica (SI E HLX C B&F CS)
please order following parts for next intervention on charger location.
3x 8EM5903-0AA00-3AA0
Kind regards,
Bas Jeurissen
